facts.fact: StackAdapt reported three-year revenue growth of 843% (vendor's own claim as stated in its press release, used for the Globe and Mail ranking).
facts.quote: StackAdapt earned its spot with three-year growth of 843%.

facts.fact: The Canada's Top Growing Companies ranking measures three-year revenue growth and is a voluntary program requiring an in-depth application process.
facts.quote: Canada’s Top Growing Companies ranks Canadian companies on three-year revenue growth.

facts.fact: In total, 400 companies made the 2019 Canada's Top Growing Companies ranking.
facts.quote: In total, 400 companies made the ranking this year.

facts.quote: The Globe and Mail newspaper reaches 6.6 million readers every week in our print or digital formats

facts.fact: Report on Business magazine reaches 1.8 million readers in print and digital every issue (publisher's own claim).
facts.quote: Report on Business magazine reaches 1.8 million readers in print and digital every issue.
